tools.name: indonesia_headlines_preview
tools.description: Free: 3 latest Indonesian headlines for a topic (Google News ID edition). Paid full feed: GET /headlines (25 headlines).

tools.name: indonesia_new_since
tools.description: Free: up to 3 Indonesian articles newer than a cursor, each with detected entities and an auditable sentiment score. Shows exactly what the paid GET /feed returns so an agent can evaluate before paying.

tools.name: indonesia_trending
tools.description: Free: who and what today's Indonesian headlines are about — top 5 entities with mention counts, a positive/neutral/negative split, and one example headline per entity. Paid GET /briefing adds the full ranking and keyword trends.

tools.name: indonesia_news_endpoints
tools.description: Free: list every paid endpoint with its current USDC price and how an x402 client should call it.

tools.name: indonesia_coverage_report
tools.description: Free quote: price and delivery for a written 30-day coverage report on a brand, person or issue. Agents buy it at /report/buy via x402 ($49); humans use /order.
